description: Rothco’s Frontline Series Patrol Pants are made for those who stand watch. As part of our Frontline Series, the Patrol Pants are crafted with utility-focused features that include a DWR coated performance rip-stop fabric with mechanical stretch, a “knee to knee” running crotch gusset for unrestricted mobility, and self-adjusting waistband, combing the functionality of a tactical pant with the professional profile of a uniform pant. Built Right: Our Patrol Pants are engineered with a water-repellent polyester / cotton micro rip-stop mechanical two-way stretch fabric for durability, reduced tearing, and reliable performance. The fabric features Durable Water Repellent (DWR) coating that shields against water and outdoor debris. Comfort Engineered for Action: The mechanical stretch pants feature a self-adjusting waistband for a perfect fit while the sure-stay shirt grip keeps your uniform top tucked in. The “knee to knee” running crotch gusset offers greater range of motion and reduced stress on the seams, allowing you to move comfortably during emergencies and demanding situations. Low-Profile Utility: The duty pants come equipped with 12 utility pockets: dual zippered low-profile cargo pockets with 2 inner firearm mag pockets, dual drop-in cell phone pockets, dual vertical “L” style front pockets with reinforced knife dock edges, and dual micro-flap back pockets for duty gear, tactical equipment, and EDC essentials. Duty-Ready: These low-profile tactical cargo pants feature duty belt sized double-stitched 2.25-inch-wide belt loops, with dual badge holder tabs at the front for easy access and clear identification. These uniform pants come standard with reinforced knee panels, internal knee pad insert access points, Prym snaps, YKK zipper fly, and cargo pocket closures. The New Standard: As part of Rothco’s Frontline Series, the Edge Pants redefine tactical readiness with a premium build that meets the demands of real-world conditions experienced by police officers, first responders, public safety, security guards, tactical professionals, and outdoor operators.
